ud6.7:1.1: evam me sutaṃ. ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Subhūti bhagavato avidūre nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ panidhāya avitakkaṃ samādhiṃ samāpajjitvā.
ud6.7:2.1: addasā kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Subhūtiṃ avidūre nisinnaṃ pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya avitakkaṃ samādhiṃ samāpannaṃ.
ud6.7:3.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
ud6.7:4.1: yassa vitakkā {vidhūpitā} ajjhattaṃ suvikappitā asesā, taṃ saṅgam aticca arūpasaññī catuyogātigato na {jātu-m-etī} 'ti. ||7||
